how_to_apply: Visit the official website upsssc.gov.in and locate the advertisement under the "Live Advertisement Segment" on the homepage.
Log in using your PET-2025 Registration Number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile number/email.
Personal details recorded in PET-2025 (name, parents' names, category, EWS, horizontal reservation details, date of birth, gender, marital status, contact details) will auto-populate.
Fill in the essential qualification (educational) details specific to this advertisement, including board/university name, year of passing, certificate number, and marks.
Enter the verification code and click Submit to generate your 11-digit application registration number; print a copy for your records.
Photo and signature uploaded during PET-2025 will display automatically (cannot be modified); click Continue.
Fill "Other Details" (preferential qualification, if any) and review the address details.
Read and accept the Declaration, tick the checkbox, enter the verification code, and click Save and Submit.
Pay the requisite fee via Credit Card / Debit Card / Internet Banking / UPI, or SBI e-Challan.
Once fee payment/reconciliation is successful, the application is auto-submitted. Download and print your final application form.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Vacancy 2026 (Category-wise)
content_sections.text: 576 Unreserved (UR) 732 Reserved Category Total 1,308 Total Posts Pay Level-5, minimum ₹29,200 – maximum ₹92,300. Posts are a mix of permanent and temporary positions. Note: The recruiting department is solely responsible for the calculation of vacancies and reservation. The number of vacancies and category-wise/sub-category-wise distribution may increase or decrease based on updated government orders on vertical and horizontal reservation.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: As per Rule 9 of the UP Animal Husbandry Department Veterinary Pharmacist Service Rules, 2025, preference in direct recruitment will be given (all else being equal) to candidates who have: Served for a minimum of 2 years in the Territorial Army, OR Obtained a National Cadet Corps (NCC) 'B' Certificate Important: Candidates must possess the essential qualification and all other required eligibility as on the last date of application (05.10.2026), along with the corresponding proof/certificates.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Selection Process & Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Selection is based solely on a written (Main) examination . Shortlisting for the Main Exam is done using the candidate's normalized PET-2025 score - category-wise, up to 15 times the number of advertised vacancies (including all candidates whose score matches the final cut-off). Total 100 objective, multiple-choice questions, 100 marks, single question paper, duration 2 hours (120 minutes) . Negative marking: ¼ (25%) of the marks for that question is deducted for each wrong answer. If the exam is held across multiple shifts/days, scores will be normalized as per the procedure notified vide Essential Information No. 42/05/Vigyapan Anu.(Eleven)/2019 dated 22 May 2019.

content_sections.text: Important: Only the last finally submitted application (with fee successfully paid/reconciled) will be considered valid. No mode other than online is accepted, and applications cannot be modified after the correction deadline of 12.10.2026 under any circumstances.

content_sections.text: High School and Intermediate (Biology) certificates & marksheets Veterinary Pharmacy Diploma certificate & marksheet Council/institution registration certificate, if applicable (currently not required in UP) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC), in the prescribed format, issued by a competent authority EWS income & asset certificate for the applicable financial year, in the prescribed format Freedom fighter dependent certificate, where applicable Disability certificate (Form II/III/IV, as applicable), for Divyangjan candidates Ex-servicemen discharge/service documents, where applicable Outstanding Sportsperson certificate, in the prescribed format, where applicable Territorial Army service proof or NCC 'B' Certificate, for preferential qualification claims

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: All reserved-category candidates from Uttar Pradesh must mark their category in the application; candidates claiming more than one reserved category will get only the single most beneficial relaxation. Candidates who are not original residents of Uttar Pradesh are not eligible for reservation and will be considered under the Unreserved category. For women candidates, the caste certificate issued in the name of the father's side alone will be accepted. EWS applicants must hold an EWS certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and 05.10.2026, based on financial year 2025-26 income, valid for financial year 2026-27. Date of birth recorded in the High School (or equivalent) certificate alone will be accepted; no other document will be considered for age proof. Providing false information, or facts that cannot be verified against valid certificates, can lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment from this and future Commission examinations/selections. Horizontal reservation category candidates will be adjusted against their own respective vertical (category) reservation. Married male candidates with more than one living spouse, and women who marry such men, are not eligible unless exempted by the Governor. The UP Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024, dated 06.08.2024, applies to this examination; malpractice, impersonation, or concealment of material facts can lead to debarment. The Commission does not correspond individually with candidates; all information is published on the official website, which candidates should check regularly. Passing the written examination does not itself confer a right to appointment. The Commission reserves the right to modify or cancel the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. How many Veterinary Pharmacist posts are available?
faq.answer: UPSSSC has notified 1,308 posts of Veterinary Pharmacist under Advt. No. 18-Pariksha/2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for this Main Examination?
faq.answer: Only candidates who appeared in PET-2025 and hold a valid (non-zero, non-negative) score can apply; shortlisting for the Main Exam is based on the normalized PET-2025 score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online registration, fee deposit, and application submission close on 05 October 2026; fee reconciliation and correction can be completed until 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 40 years as on 01 July of the notified vacancy year, subject to applicable relaxation for reserved categories and UP government employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: High School and Intermediate (Biology), along with a 2-year 3-month Veterinary Pharmacy diploma from a recognized institution; council registration is currently not required in UP.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹25 online processing fee for all categories (UR/OBC/SC/ST); no separate application fee is charged at this stage.

faq.question: Q7. What is the exam pattern?
faq.answer: A single objective paper of 100 questions/100 marks, 2 hours duration, with ¼ negative marking per wrong answer.
